messages:
Carla R: Short playbook proposal: operator-issued ephemeral client certs for tenant private endpoints, staged by region, fallback to shared regional endpoint.
Alice M: Key risks: preserved src IP requirements and DNS/client caching. Per-tenant peering preserves srcip but increases VPC attachments and route churn.
Brian W: Recommendation: gate per-tenant peering to enterprise SLA; default to shared endpoint with documented SNAT semantics.
Matt K: Air-gapped flow: customer generates CSR, operator signs offline or customer brings cert. Offline TTL longer (24h) and manual rotation steps required.
Jen S: Minimal operator API routes: POST /operator/tenants/:id/bootstrap, POST /.../certs (create), PUT /.../renew, DELETE /.../revoke. Operator should emit handshake traces.
Carla R: Rollout: (1) observe-only collection, (2) 8-12 non-prod canaries in one region, (3) nightly regional ramps, (4) proxy-level auto-fallback to shared endpoint for 10m on handshake spike, (5) Console manual rollback.
sre-bot: Alerts to add: controlplane.handshake.error_rate >1% (5m), cert_renew.failures, peer.route_churn.high.
Brian W: I'll produce a cost delta for per-tenant peering vs shared endpoint and propose gating/pricing by next Tue.
Matt K: I'll own offline docs and agent compatibility (require agent v2.1+ for production cutover with RenewFromOperator support).
Carla R: I'll open RFC follow-up PR with API spec and migration runbook; target internal beta behind feature flag in ~3 weeks.
